CompletionStep.rules: Counts nonnegative and sum exactly total: validate by guarded remaining subtraction to avoid overflow. Priority invalid counts -> INVALID_COUNTS, invalid exact status -> INVALID_STATUS, total==INT64_MAX -> COUNTER_CAPACITY. Invalid output all six counts0, valid=false,complete=false. Otherwise increase total and matching counter by1 only after guard; valid=true, complete=pass==total,reason=ACCUMULATED.

CompletionFinish.rules: Same count validation; invalid counts -> zeroed invalid decision INVALID_COUNTS. Valid empty counts -> zeroed invalid decision NO_RECORDS (public nonempty boundary extension, not private summarize([]) equivalence). Valid nonempty preserves all counts,valid=true,complete=(pass==total),reason=ALL_PASS if complete else NON_PASS_RESULTS.

CompletionReady.rules: Summary counters validated overflow safely. Coverage facts: required>0, matched/unexpected/observed>=0,matched<=required,observed>=matched and observed-matched==unexpected. counts_ok=both counter and coverage-fact invariants. coverage_ok=coverage facts valid &&matched==required&&unexpected==0. summary_ok=summary.valid&&total>0&&total==observed&&summary.complete==(pass==total). all_pass_ok=summary counters valid&&total>0&&pass==total&&summary.complete. ready=all four flags. All flags computed independently. Reason priority !counts_ok INVALID_COUNTS -> !coverage_ok INCOMPLETE_CLAIM_COVERAGE -> !summary_ok INVALID_COMPLETION_SUMMARY -> !all_pass_ok NON_PASS_RESULTS -> READY.

core_scope: Generic consistent int64 counters and one status per step. API is not restricted to four slots; 0..4 counters/sequences are only finite test domains. Host CLI supports0..256 observed records and1..256 required claims with strict size bounds.

record_fields.evidence_ids: 1..256 unique ev_ followed by64lowercasehex; same ID across different claims allowed

host.argv: --policy required operator-selected local policy file, --input file|- defaultstdin, --replay optional; policy never accepted in regular input payload
host.normalization: Preserve complete original input/policy and record order; fold every observed record through compiled Gooo; no host implementation of status counts or completion predicates. Compute matched/unexpected/missing claim sets against separately loaded policy, sorted missing/unexpected output. Duplicate claim/evidenceIDs and invalid labels are inputerrors; missing/unexpected claims produce complete not-ready report. Empty observed list produces not-ready NO_RECORDS. Do not continue after invalid native decision.
host.replay: Load current policy independently again, verify it/current bytes against report; recompute all decisions/steps/coverage/bindings and require exact typed complete report equality; reject any change.
host.scope: Unsigned completion check of supplied verifier outcomes, not evidence authentication, RFC8785 full Rea ledger compatibility, target tool execution or permission grant. Machine workflow owns policyfile/argv and establishes authenticated evidence facts before feeding records.

scope: Supplied verifier status counts and required-claim coverage. Host owns current policy, input identity, evidence authentication and downstream dispatch. No per-call human approval condition is required by this relation.
